svg.title: Drag to reorder, and recommended apps
svg.desc: A glass dock with seven pinned apps, a divider, three recommended apps (Notes, Mail, Calendar) and a plus button. A pointer grabs the Files icon, lifts it and drags it to the right; the neighbouring icons glide one slot to the left to open a gap that follows the dragged icon, and it settles after the fifth app. Then the three recommended apps are highlighted as recent and frequent apps that are closed, a settings toggle labelled Show recommended apps switches off, the recommended apps collapse and the dock narrows, then the toggle switches back on and the dock returns to its initial state.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
